# lxephemeris

> Clean-room, thread-safe (`Send + Sync`), zero-`unsafe` (`#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`) astronomical and astrological ephemeris engine in Rust (`lxephemeris-core`) with native Python (`lxephemeris`), Node.js / TypeScript (`lxephemeris-node`), and CLI (`lxephemeris-cli`) bindings. Engineered to completely replace Swiss Ephemeris (`pyswisseph` / `libswe`), `PyEphem` (`ephem`), and `Kerykeion`'s astronomical calculation layer while eliminating 22 documented upstream bugs (`SWE-01..SWE-11`, `EPH-01..EPH-05`, `KER-01..KER-06`) and verified against a **32,416-vector Golden Reference Database** (`105+` Rust tests, `15` Python test suites, `11` Node.js test suites).

## Core Capabilities

- **Dual Backend — High-Precision JPL/IMCCE SPK (`DE440s`/`DE440`/`DE441`/`INPOP21a`) + Fileless `DE440`-Calibrated `TrigLadder` Moshier Mode (`SEFLG_MOSEPH`)**:
  - **SPK Mode (`SEFLG_SWIEPH`)**: 10 major bodies (`Sun..Pluto`) from JPL `DE440s` (`1849–2150` standard bundle; extendable to `DE440` `1550–2650`, `DE441` `-13200..+17191`, or `INPOP21a` via `lxephemeris-cli fetch-kernel`) and 68 astrological asteroids, centaurs, and TNOs (`Ceres..Makemake`, `Chiron`, `Pholus`, `Nessus`, `Eris`, `Sedna`, `Haumea`, arbitrary `mpc:<number>`).
  - **Fileless Moshier Mode & Zero-Threshold Initialization (`Engine()` / `new Engine()` / `Engine::default()` / `Engine.new_moshier()` / `Engine.from_data_dir_or_moshier()` / `SEFLG_MOSEPH`)**: Zero-dependency `DE440`-calibrated `TrigLadder` analytical ephemeris covering `-3000 CE .. +3000 CE` (`JD [625307.5, 2816787.5]`) with **0 bytes of external `.bsp` files required** (auto-detecting `LXEPHEMERIS_DATA_DIR` / `SE_EPHE_PATH` when set).
  - **Single-Pass Analytical Velocity Jacobian (`12.77 µs` per body with speeds, `242.56 µs` per full natal chart)**: Differentiates SPK Chebyshev polynomials, relativistic light-time ($\dot{\tau}$), aberration, gravitational deflection, and the IAU 2006/2000A frame rotation matrix ($\dot{\mathbf{R}}$) analytically in a single pass.
- **Lunar Points, Planetary Nodes & Apsides (`nod_aps`), & Hypothetical Bodies**:
  - 4 Lunar Nodes (`Mean_Node`, `True_Node`, `Mean_South_Node`, `True_South_Node`), 3 Black Moon Liliths (`Mean_Lilith`, `True_Lilith`, and $C^2$ cubic-spline `Interpolated_Lilith`), 8 Hamburg Uranian planets (`Cupido..Poseidon`), and `Transpluto` (`Isis`).
  - Full `nod_aps` / `nod_aps_ut` for Moon, planets, and 68 minor bodies supporting `SE_NODBIT_MEAN`, `SE_NODBIT_OSCU`, `SE_NODBIT_OSCU_BAR`, and `SE_NODBIT_FOPOINT` (second ellipse focus).
- **52 Embedded Fixed Stars (Hipparcos-2 I/311 + XHIP V/137D) + Custom `sefstars.txt` / JSON Catalog Loader & Heliacal Phenomena**:
  - VizieR Hipparcos-2 (`I/311`) + XHIP (`V/137D`) 3D space motion (`pmpx`), visual magnitude (`vmag`), custom catalog loader (`load_custom_stars`), star parans (`rise_trans` with proper motion), and Bradley Schaefer (*arcus visionis*) heliacal risings and settings.
- **Planetary Phenomena & Visual Magnitudes (`phenomena` / `pheno_ut`)**:
  - Phase angle, illuminated fraction, solar elongation, apparent angular diameter, and Mallama & Hilton (2018) / IAU $(H, G)$ apparent visual magnitude (`Vmag`) for Sun, Moon, planets, and all 68 minor bodies (also populated on `CalcResult.magnitude_v`).
- **43 Sidereal Ayanamsas + `SE_SIDM_USER` & 23 House Systems + 3D `house_pos`**:
  - All 43 `SE_SIDM_*` ayanamsas (`0..=42`, including Lahiri, True Citra, Raman, Krishnamurti, Fagan-Bradley, Galen, Babylonian, Suryasiddhanta, etc.) plus `SE_SIDM_USER = 255` custom `(t0, ayan_t0)`.
  - All 23 case-sensitive house systems (`P, K, O, R, C, A, W, B, M, T, U, X, V, L, Q, I, i, F, N, S, D, Y, H`), 8 chart angles, 36 Gauquelin sectors, `houses_armc`, `house_of_lon` (`eps = 1e-9°`), 3D mundane `house_pos` accounting for ecliptic latitude $\beta$, and configurable `PolarPolicy` (`strict`, `fallback_to_whole_sign`, `fallback_to_porphyry`).
- **Solar & Lunar Eclipses + Lunar Occultations (`lun_occult_when_glob` / `lun_occult_when_loc`)**:
  - Global and local topocentric Besselian elements for solar eclipses, lunar eclipses, and lunar occultations of fixed stars, planets, and asteroids; contacts (`P1, U1, U2, U3, U4, P4` and `C1..C4`), Saros series & member numbers, path width (`km`), central duration (`s`), Danjon `1/85` & traditional `2%` shadow rules, and range searches.
- **Equation of Time (`time_equation` / `time_equ`) & Inverse Horizontal (`azalt_rev`)**:
  - Apparent minus mean solar time in days (`swe_time_equ`) and inverse horizontal-to-equatorial / horizontal-to-ecliptic coordinate conversion (`swe_azalt_rev`).
- **Astronomical Event Solvers, Chinese 24 Solar Terms, Human Design, Lunar Phase Summary, & Brady Parans (`Wave F`)**:
  - **Ecliptic Longitude Crossings & Returns (`search_body_longitude`, `body_longitude_crossings_in_range`)**: Safeguarded Newton-Illinois root-finding (`< 1e-9°` / `< 0.01 s`) for Tropical and Sidereal zodiacs, including 3-pass retrograde triple returns (`R9.1`, `R9.2`).
  - **Chinese 24 Solar Terms & 4 Cardinal Seasons (`solar_terms_in_range`, `seasons_in_year`)**: Exact geocentric apparent tropical solar longitude multiples of $15^\circ$ (`Chunfen..Jingzhe`) and $90^\circ$ (`0°, 90°, 180°, 270°`), permanently eliminating the `ephem.Sun().hlong` $180^\circ$ heliocentric inversion bug (`R12`, `EPH-01`).
  - **Human Design `-88°` Solar Arc Solver (`human_design_epoch`)**: Exact prenatal design epoch where $\lambda_\odot(t_{\text{design}}) = (\lambda_{\text{birth}} - 88^\circ) \pmod{360^\circ}$ (`R9.2`).
  - **Lunar Phases & Complete Kerykeion Replacement (`search_lunar_phase`, `lunar_phases_in_range`, `lunar_phase_summary`)**: Principal quarters and arbitrary lunar-solar elongations, plus `LunarPhaseSummary` with moon age (`age_days`), `synodic_fraction`, `moon_dist_km`, 8-phase octant (`0..=7`), and 28-phase (`1..=28`) index replacing `kerykeion.calculate_moon_phase` and `ephem.next_new_moon` / `ephem.previous_new_moon` (`R0`, `R2.2`, `R9.2`).
  - **Planetary Stations & Declination Extrema (`search_stations_in_range`, `search_declination_extrema_in_range`)**: Exact stationary points $\dot{\lambda}(t) = 0$ (`StationRetrograde` / `StationDirect`) in Tropical or Sidereal zodiacs, and northern/southern declination standstills / lunistices $\dot{\delta}(t) = 0$ (`NorthernMaximum` / `SouthernMinimum`, `R9.2`).
  - **Bernadette Brady Diurnal Fixed-Star Parans (`find_parans`)**: Full 52-star (plus custom catalog stars) × 10-planet airless geometric-center diurnal angle solver (`"rising"`, `"culminating"`, `"setting"`, `"anti-culminating"`) with 3D Hipparcos-2 space motion and circular diurnal time orb sorting (`R6.2`, `EPH-03`).
- **Aspects, Transits, Planetary Returns, Vedic Panchanga/Dasha/Vargas, Traditional Lots, 64 HD Gates, & Interactive CLI (`Wave H`)**:
  - **Planetary Returns (`planetary_return`, `planetary_returns_in_range`)**: Tropical & Sidereal Solar, Lunar, and Planetary Returns with retrograde multi-pass numbering (`pass_index = 1..3`).
  - **Aspects & Transits (`calc_chart_aspects`, `calc_synastry_aspects`, `calc_declination_aspects`, `search_exact_aspect`, `mutual_aspects_in_range`, `natal_transits_in_range`, `void_of_course_moon_in_range`)**: Static natal/synastry/declination aspects with analytical `is_applying`, dynamic exact aspect root-finding across retrograde loops, and Void-of-Course Moon intervals.
  - **Vedic Jyotish (`panchanga`, `vimshottari_dasha`, `calc_varga`, `calc_shodashavarga`)**: 5-limb Panchanga (`Vara`, `Tithi`, `Nakshatra + Pada`, `Yoga`, `Karana`) with exact transition JDs and Muhurta windows (`Rahukalam`, `Yamagandam`, `Gulikakalam`, `Abhijit Muhurta`), 120-year Vimshottari Mahadasha/Antardasha schedule, and all 16 Parashara Shodashavarga divisional charts (`D1..D60`).
  - **Traditional Western, 64 Human Design Gates, & Single-Call Snapshot (`chart_sect`, `planetary_hours`, `calc_lots`, `map_zodiac_placement`, `chart_snapshot`)**: Diurnal/nocturnal sect, 24 unequal Chaldean planetary hours, 7 Hermetic Lots of Paulus Alexandrinus, 64 Human Design Gates (`Gate 1..64`, `Line 1..6`, `Color 1..6`, `Tone 1..6`, `Base 1..5` starting at $302^\circ 00'$ Aquarius = Gate 41 Line 1), and one-call `chart_snapshot`.
  - **Interactive CLI (`lxephemeris-cli`)**: `calc`, `houses`, `panchanga`, `swetest` (drop-in Swiss Ephemeris CLI replacement), `validate-bundle`, `data-sync`, `fetch-kernel`, and `chart-bench`.
- **22 Upstream Bug Immunity Guarantees & 32,416-Vector Golden Reference Database (`Wave G`)**:
  - Eliminates **`SWE-01..SWE-11`** (Swiss Ephemeris), **`EPH-01..EPH-05`** (PyEphem), and **`KER-01..KER-06`** (Kerykeion).
  - Continuously verified against **32,416 golden reference vectors** (`l3_se_10k_grid.json` [10,242], `l3_wave_bcf_10k_grid.json` [10,540], `l3_wave_g_extreme_10k_grid.json` [10,000], plus `1,634` L1A/L1B/L3 vectors) across **`105+` Rust tests**, **`15` Python test suites**, and **`11` Node.js test suites**.
- **100% Drop-In Swiss Ephemeris Migration (`SweAdapter`)**:
  - Instance-scoped `SweAdapter` / `JsSweAdapter` supporting `SE_*` body constants, `SEFLG_*` bitflags (including `SEFLG_MOSEPH`), `SE_SIDM_*` ayanamsa IDs (`0..=42` + `255`), `SE_NODBIT_*`, and `calc_ut`, `calc`, `fixstar2_ut`, `fixstar2_mag`, `pheno_ut`, `pheno`, `nod_aps_ut`, `nod_aps`, `lun_occult_when_glob`, `lun_occult_when_loc`, `houses_ex`, `houses_armc`, `house_pos`, `get_ayanamsa_ex_ut`, `deltat`, `time_equ`, `sidtime`, `azalt`, `azalt_rev`, `rise_trans`, `julday`, and `revjul`.
